ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted thru 11/30 to College of Business students; LAS Finance, Actuarial Science, & Econ majors; and ACES Agri-Finance, Agri-Accounting, & Consumer Economics majors. Any remaining seats will open to all interested students at approximately noon on December 1. Business Minors will NOT receive registration priority in spring semester. PREREQUISITES (ACCY 202 & ECON 203) WILL BE ENFORCED. Students who do not have the appropriate pre-reqs will be removed from the course. FIN 221 now includes an online component, which has replaced the Monday lecture session. Additional information about online requirements will be provided in class.
